blocks.text: OKLAHOMA CITY — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander paused when asked what he learned about himself and his game over the summer. “I didn’t learn anything I didn’t already know,” he said. “I feel like I got better this summer, for sure.” That’s great news for the Oklahoma City Thunder, a team that won the NBA title in 2025 and lost a Game 7 to the San Antonio Spurs in last season’s Western Conference finals. Gilgeous-Alexander — bidding for a third straight MVP award — and the Thunder are widely expected to be top contenders for a title again this season. READ: NBA: A […]...
